title: incidents
text:
incidents

Incident Bot: INC-2147 opened by Jordan Blake — Private installer rollbacks looping (possible RRB-17). Impact: 2 customers blocked on upgrade.
Jordan Blake: triage: customers report "upgrade rollback stuck" / "reverting forever". seeing repeated rollback attempts in controller logs
Ava Chen: customer 1 is Acme (private), customer 2 is Northwind (private). both on 2.8.0 -> 2.9.0
Ethan Park: correlates w/ eng thread yesterday. workaround seems to be deleting rollback lock CM + restarting controller
Priya Natarajan: root cause hypothesis: rollback cleanup hook fails when CRD migration partially applied; lock never cleared; controller backoff loop
Dev Patel: do we have a safe script for lock removal? want to avoid nuking unrelated CMs
Ethan Park: can scope by label `app=redwood-installer` and name `installer-rollback-lock` only
Jordan Blake: next steps: 1) CS share workaround + guardrails 2) open INT ticket for patch; 3) update runbook
Ava Chen: Ill email customer w/ steps + ask for logs snapshot
Incident Bot: Status update requested: add customer comms + ETA for patch.
